, received a $234.46M U.S. Army contract modification to procure 16 UH-60M Black Hawk helicopters.
The modification raises the contract’s cumulative value to $356.25M under contract W58RGZ-26-C-0008.
The helicopters will be manufactured in Stratford, Connecticut, with work scheduled for completion by June 30, 2028.
The U.S. Army obligated the full $234.46M in FY2026 aircraft procurement funds at the time of the award.
Army Contracting Command at Redstone Arsenal, Alabama, is responsible for the contract.
